messages:
nina: Heads-up: we're changing the invoice cutoff window by +4h for two billing cycles to smooth day-end meter spikes. Not a price change.

sam: who is in scope? hosted, dedicated, private?

nina: hosted + Dedicated auto. Private customers get an opt-in script and a heads-up email.

support-lead: will this affect free credits? customers asking.

nina: free credits unchanged; credits are applied before any burst-exemption logic for these cycles.

billing-bot: Invoice cron updated: old=UTC 00:00 -> new=UTC 04:00 for cycles starting 2026-07-01.

leo: marketing + AE notified. we'll post a banner and send partner sample invoices.

nina: action items: post KB, update console banner, infra to monitor metering windows for 2 cycles. :white_check_mark:
thread_text_searchable: invoice cutoff +4h two cycles hosted Dedicated Private opt-in credits unchanged banner KB
